login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the username and password your manager gave you.
login.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet to sign in.

errors.invalidCredentials: That username or password is not right. Check both and try again.
errors.inactive: This account is not active. Ask your manager to turn it back on.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Sign-in did not work. Try again, or ask your manager.

ended.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
ended.inactive: This account is not active any more. Ask your manager.

mfa.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for this account.
mfa.setupBody: Admin accounts need a second step. Scan the code with an authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
mfa.secretLabel: Or enter this key by hand
mfa.wrongCode: That code did not work. Check the time on your phone and try again.
mfa.setupFailed: Two-step sign-in could not be set up. Try again.
mfa.lostDevice: Lost the phone with your codes? Ask another admin to reset your two-step sign-in.

shell.notAvailableTitle: No screens for this role yet
shell.notAvailableBody: Rider screens arrive in Phase 3. Sign out to use another account.
shell.notFoundBody: Go back to your home screen.
shell.errorBody: Reload the app. If it happens again, tell your manager.
shell.updateReady: A new version of the app is ready.
shell.offlineReady: The app is ready to work with a weak connection.
